Alyssa: Running an apples-to-apples smoke between the replay harness and the synthetic generator for a mixed-seqlen workload and seeing a 15-25% p95 regression on the replay side. Anyone seen this pattern before? :thinking:
Mateo: Which testbed + image + driver?
Alyssa: gpu-x86-prod-rt (A100 80GB), driver 525.89, CUDA 12.2, image `redwood/infer:2026-03-cuda12.2`. Replay harness = replay-harness v2 with mixed lengths; synth = synth-gen v1.4 fixed-length. Profiling shows lots of tiny memcpy peaks and repeated small kernel launches around KV cache handling. Snippet:```nvtx: range(memcpyHtoD) 0.8ms
nvtx: range(kv_fetch) 1.2ms
nvtx: range(cudaMemcpy) 0.9ms
...lots of 200-800us memcpy spikes```
Priya: That smells like KV cache thrash when sequence length varies. The repeated small allocations + page migrations can show up as memcpy spikes. Did you check for page faults / THP?
infra-bot: Collected quick sysinfo from the node:```$ cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled
[always] madvise never
$ free -h
Mem:  503G total,  480G used,  23G free
$ nvidia-smi -q | grep -i 'Driver Version'
Driver Version : 525.89```
Mateo: THP enabled (+ high memory use) — that can cause latency jitter because the kernel will collapse/fallback pages, especially under many small GPU allocations. We hit this before with kvcache churn. Try disabling:```sudo bash -c 'echo never > /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled'``` or set `transparent_hugepage=never` on boot.
Alyssa: Did that on the same node and re-ran the replay harness. p95 went back within 3% of synth baseline. So THP + mixed-seqlen replay = allocator/page-splitting thrash, not a kernel selector issue. Interesting that synth didn't show it because fixed seqlen avoids repeated small allocations. :eyes: 
Priya: Good catch. Two follow-ups: 1) add a mixed-seqlen test to our perf CI (replay-style) so this surfaces earlier, 2) run a small driver/CUDA/image matrix to see if newer driver or CUDA mitigates the behavior (maybe fragmentation/alloc changes in 535/CUDA 12.3).
Mateo: I'll spin up a 6-run matrix: A100/H100 x driver {525.89,535.86} x CUDA {12.2,12.3} using images `redwood/infer:2026-03-cuda12.2` and `redwood/infer:2026-03-cuda12.3` and run the mixed-seqlen replay job. Will attach nvtx traces + `nsys` captures.
Alyssa: Perfect. Also adding a tiny repro script in the repo would help debugging for infra. I'll open a PR with a Dockerfile and the `nsys` capture example.
Priya: After we confirm matrix, we should document the recommended node sysctl (THP disabled) and add a check in the loadtest runner that warns if THP is enabled.
Mateo: Agreed. Quick command to include in runner healthcheck:```if grep -q '\[always\]' /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled; then echo 'THP enabled'; fi```
Alyssa: Thanks all — moving this to action items. I'll post results from the driver matrix here when Matt finishes the runs. :thumbsup:
